niphal.sense_hint: simple (this root has no attested qal; niphal serves as its basic/citation stem)

notes: True homograph of the existing H6279 (עָתַר, "pray") -- same bare consonants עתר, genuinely unrelated meanings -- added as עתר² (higher Strong's number) per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention; H6279 is retroactively renamed עתר¹ in this same batch.

No attested qal. Primary/citation stem: niphal ("be abundant", Prov.27.6), matching Strong's own headline gloss "to be (causatively, make) abundant" which presents the basic/stative sense first and the causative (hiphil "multiply") as its derived extension; no DEFAULT_STEM_OVERRIDE entry is needed since niphal already precedes hiphil in STEM_ORDER.

Prov.27.6's נַעְתָּרוֹת is often rendered contextually as "deceitful" or "profuse" (kisses of an enemy) rather than literally "abundant" -- ESV's "profuse" is a direct synonym of "abundant" and is used here as the citation-matching sense; the more moralized "deceitful" rendering reflects the verse's irony (excess affection read as insincere) rather than a different literal meaning of the verb.
